scripts.types:gen: rc=0; for d in plugins/*/; do CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIR_WATCH=1 claude -p 'reply with ok' --plugin-dir "$d" || rc=1; done; exit $rc
scripts.types:check: for d in plugins/*/; do tsc -p "$d" || exit 1; done
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate . && for d in plugins/*/; do claude plugin validate "$d" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for d in plugins/*/; do claude plugin test "$d" || exit 1; done
